svg.text: 5-CH K-TYPE BLE DATA LOGGER · 五通道 K 型熱電偶 BLE 記錄器
CH583M + 5 x SD6500 (SDIC) + CE8503 buck · AFE = IC-factory SDH260018 V1.0-2 (renumbered) · CH583M QFN48 pins per WCH datasheet V1.9 · Flash / LCD parts TBD
P POWER · 4 x AA → reverse-polarity P-MOS → CE8503AM buck → VCC_3V3 (user's schematic + recommended changes)
• Vout = 0.6 V × (1 + R29/R30) = 0.6 × (1 + 453k/100k) = 3.32 V (VFB 0.6 V ±2 %); divider current ≈ 6 µA (was 15 µA with 180k/39k).
• VIN 2.0–6.5 V (abs.max 7.5 V): fresh alkaline 4×AA ≈ 6.0–6.4 V is OK with ~0.1 V margin; do NOT use 4×lithium AA (7.2 V).
• CHANGES vs the original drawing: R29/R30 453k/100k, C38 22→10 pF (keeps the datasheet's feed-forward zero, computed not tested),
• C39 tantalum→polymer, + R31 EN pull-up, + Q1/R32 reverse-polarity protection, + R33/R34/C40 battery sense to a CH583 ADC pin.
• VBAT_SENSE = 0.294 × VBAT (6.4 V → 1.88 V, 3.6 V → 1.06 V): inside the CH583 ADC 0 dB range (recommended 0–2 V, Vref 1.05 V). Check buck stability with the polymer C39.
M MCU GPIO (U1A) · SPI FLASH · SPI LCD (CH583M QFN48 pins: WCH datasheet V1.9; Flash / LCD parts TBD)

N COLD-JUNCTION NTC NETWORK (shared) · on SD6500 #1 only · 冷端補償
R_NTC = R902 × V(AI11-ACM1) / V(AI17-AI11) (ratiometric; AVDDR cancels)
Chain current ≈ (AVDDR-ACM)/1.11 MΩ ≈ 1.6 µA at AVDDR = 3.0 V (negligible self-
V(AI17-AI11) ≈ 160 mV; V(AI11-ACM1) ≈ 16 mV @25 °C, 45 mV @0 °C, 7 mV @50 °C → PGIA
Brief said 'midpoint to AI6 and AI7' — that reads 0 V differentially and uses up ACM;
factory topology above (AI1/AI7 pair, ACM1 stays available as the bias for T1).
Factory file lists these resistors as 5 %: R902 must be 0.1 % (25 ppm) for CJC
V1.0 → V1.0-2 fix: NTC1 / C902 bottom was on a separate net 'ACM' (not tied to ACM1).
Place NTC1 at the centre of the T1–T5 jack row, on the same copper island (see docs).
C CH583M SUPPORT (U1B) · power pins, DC-DC, crystals, antenna, reset / boot, SWD, UART1 (per WCH datasheet V1.9 + EVT schematic)
CH583M (QFN48) · unit B: power / RF / debug
Decoupling at the pins (no vias between cap and pin)
VDDx pins: C41 on VDD33/VIO33 (pin 3); C42 on VDCID; C43 on VDCIA (tied to VDCID); C44 on VINTA.
L1 fitted so the DC-DC can be enabled in software; with DC-DC off it is just a DC path VSW → VDCID.
32 MHz: internal load caps (10–24 pF), none external (as the WCH EVT).
32.768 kHz: optional, for an accurate RTC / BLE sleep clock.
Unused GPIO (no connect, free for expansion): PA5, PA6, PA7, PB7, PB9–PB13, PB16–PB21.
ADC: PA4 = AIN0, 12-bit, Vref 1.05 V, 0 dB, input buffer ON (3.4 MΩ source). DATA1–5 = PB2–PB6 (one port read samples all five).
VIO ≤ VIO33 + 0.4 V (abs. max): VBAT_SENSE may precede VCC_3V3 for ~ms at battery insertion; current is < 1 µA through 2.4 MΩ.
AFE netlist is the IC factory's SDH260018 V1.0-2 verbatim (round-trip checked), only renumbered. Factory refdes ↔ ours: docs/FACTORY_V1_TO_V2.md.
DEVIATIONS from factory: C304 / C404 / C504 are 0.1 µF here (factory file has 10 µF on the second VDD cap of U3/U4/U5 — to be confirmed); R902 = 0.1 %.
OPEN: SPI Flash / LCD part numbers, Y1/Y2 crystal specs and antenna tuning (WCH EVT BOM / PCB notes), AI1/AI7 of U12–U15 left floating (confirm with SDIC).
